title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] Course Introduction
description:
CLO Beginner's Course - Course Guide, leading you through CLO registration and installation, understanding course content, how to obtain materials, and other preliminary information.  
CLO China Official Website: https://clo3d-china.com  
CONNECT Official Store: https://connect.clo-set.com/zh  
Click the link to download image materials: Shared via cloud drive: Materials(1).zip  
Link: https://pan.baidu.com/s/1Tu4p_FDdQnG2ENnH-8PgYw  Extraction code: ya5c
transcript:
Hello everyone, welcome to the series of classes for learning Cloth newbie entry.  
If you are interested in 3D fashion design but lack the basics or direction,  
this course is created for you.  
This course will guide you from scratch,  
systematically processing the core logic of 3D fashion modeling,  
to help you quickly cross the newbie threshold,  
and truly use this powerful tool for yourself.  

First of all, I will introduce you to Cloth account registration and installation.  
You can visit the website cloth3d-china.com,  
which is the official website in China.  
You can also access Cloth 3D or the official Cloth Chinese website through your browser.  
Go to the official website and click on the login button in the upper right corner.  
On the login page, click the registration button in the lower right corner.  
Select personal or student user registration.  
Note that the Cloth site account is registered here.  
You can use the same account to log in to all Cloth products without error,  
such as Cloth software, Cloth site platform, and Connect merchant, etc.  
Enter your email and mobile phone number to complete the Cloth site account registration.  
Complete mobile phone verification.  
You can choose according to personal needs  
to subscribe to product-related emails at the bottom of the page.  
Then click on create account.  
Follow the prompts to go to your mailbox and complete the verification.  
This way, the Cloth account is registered.  
After email verification, it will automatically redirect to the Cloth Chinese official website.  
At this time, the account has been logged in.  
You can click on the image in the upper right corner to check the account.  
You can also click logout to log in with another account.  

After registration, you can see the free trial option in the upper right corner.  
New users have a 14-day free trial of Cloth software.  
Click on the download button.  
You will be taken to the download page for the Cloth installation package.  
You need to select the installation package suitable for your computer system,  
either Mac or Windows system.  
Because 3D modeling has certain requirements for computer performance,  
before downloading the installation,  
you can click on the bottom right corner  
to check the computer configuration requirements,  
to ensure that the software can be used normally after installation.  

After confirming the computer configuration,  
go back to the download page,  
download the Cloth installation package,  
and wait for the download to complete.  
This is the downloaded Cloth installation package.  
On the top right, you can choose to run as administrator.  
Follow the video steps to complete the installation.  
I recommend that you install it under the C drive.  
Finally, click finish.  
A pop-up will appear explaining the update and repair function of the Cloth version.  
Just click close.  

After installation,  
find the Cloth software icon on the desktop,  
double-click to open the software.  
On the first start,  
you need to agree to the service terms,  
click Yes.  
Log in again.  
Click Sign in with Clothset to log in with Clothset.  
In the pop-up page,  
enter the email account and password you just registered.  
After logging in, it will show that you have now logged in to Clothset.  
You can return to Cloth to continue.  
At this time, Cloth will also pop up the login window  
when logging in for the first time after installation.  

In the initial settings,  
we can click on the second option,  
click the download menu,  
set the language to Simplified Chinese,  
then click OK to complete the installation.  
Then click OK to confirm login.  
This pop-up window reminds you  
how many days the software will expire  
and the specific expiration date.  

During the trial period,  
you can click the subscribe button below the date  
to pay for it.  
Or if the trial period of the software is over  
and you still want to continue using Cloth software,  
you can visit the Chinese official website,  
on the pricing page above,  
click to view the pricing plans or subscribe to the software.  
Click to confirm and close the window.  

After opening the software,  
if you need to switch the interface language,  
you can select the language option in the top settings of the software to switch.  
After changing, restart the software to take effect.  

This completes the registration and installation preparation work.  
Next, go back to the Cloth Chinese official website,  
and see the learning tab above.  
There are tutorials, training camps, handbooks, and community forums.  

First, click on the tutorial.  
It will redirect to the official Cloth Bilibili account.  
Here, we will continue to upload the latest tutorials  
and previous information.  
This course is a new entry course in the Cloth tutorial series,  
designed to help beginners easily get started  
and quickly master the skills to use Cloth software.  

In addition, we also provide two advanced series courses:  
Designers’ Specialties and Master Classes.  
If you have completed the entry course  
or have a basic level of Cloth,  
you can take these to further learn various advanced production techniques.  

Designers’ Specialties  
is designed for designers,  
3D design and production courses from scratch.  
Wu Zhiyang in Cloth  
Cloth clothing sample design  
also based on the basic model library,  
changes the design,  
and various floral design,  
style design skills.  

Master Class  
contains more complex product style teaching,  
advanced complex fabric processing,  
and a series of exhibitions and scenes,  
content such as scenery construction and rendering.  
It is suitable for everyone at a deeper learning stage  
or those who have special product type production needs.  

Additionally,  
we will continue to update some small technique videos on using Cloth,  
for example, how to wear a button,  
connection advantages,  
self-defined buttons and name lines, etc.  
You can choose to learn them by default.  

Because Cloth software has been continuously optimized and updated,  
when a new version is released,  
we will also launch a new function series video at the same time,  
to help everyone quickly upgrade  
and master the latest technology.  

Next,  
let’s specifically look at the content of the new entry course.  
This course is divided into two stages.  
Currently, the first half is released.  
The second half will be released soon.  
We suggest everyone watch the course once.  

First, through the Cloth Ecosystem,  
to understand the Cloth product ecosystem.  
By watching the course guide,  
clear preliminary information,  
complete preparation.  

Then the third and fourth small steps quickly enter the core tools.  
We will guide you to master Cloth basic tools  
and the basic process of 3D clothing production.  

The fifth small step, material,  
will focus on explaining  
concepts and applications related to material analysis.  

In the sixth section, simulation control,  
we will add practical tools through actual case studies  
to improve your 3D simulation control ability.  

Regarding the acquisition of course materials,  
this includes two parts.  

The first is the Cloth file materials.  
Related materials have been uploaded to Connect Business.  
You can download them directly from Cloth software.  
Open Cloth software,  
click the blue icon in the upper right corner,  
open the library,  
switch to the Connect tab.  
This is the same as our Connect online mall.  
You can use the selection options or keywords  
to unlock the required materials.  
For selected materials,  
you can right-click to add them to the shopping cart  
or open them in the Connect webpage.  

The second is the picture materials.  
All reference pictures used in the teaching  
will be placed in the network disk link below this video.  
You can directly click to extract them.  
Of course, you can also use your own pictures  
to create.  

In addition, we will also hold training camps regularly,  
provide customized courses for business users and university users,  
and senior talent classes for face-to-face public registration.  
Those who are interested can join.  

During the learning process,  
if you want to know more about how to use functions,  
you can also click on the manual  
to unlock the corresponding function instructions.  

Finally, you can also  
find the community forum in the learning menu at the top of the website.  
Join our official exchange community.  
You are welcome to discuss with us  
any problems you encounter while using the software,  
share your work.  

We will also hold fun activities and creative competitions,  
with various exquisite surrounding gifts waiting for you.  
Looking forward to seeing you in the community.

chunks.title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] Course Introduction
chunks.content: # CLO Beginner's Guide: Course Introduction This document provides a detailed introduction to the Cloth 3D software, covering account registration, installation, course structure, learning resources, and community engagement. It is designed for beginners interested in 3D fashion design using Cloth, explaining core concepts, software setup, and available learning pathways. --- ## Overview of Cloth 3D and Course Purpose This section introduces Cloth 3D as a powerful tool for 3D fashion modeling and outlines the course’s goal to help beginners systematically learn the core logic and practical skills to use Cloth effectively. - Cloth 3D is a tool for 3D fashion design. - The course guides users from scratch through core concepts and software usage. - The goal is to help beginners quickly cross the newbie threshold and utilize Cloth for their own projects. --- ## Account Registration and Software Installation This section describes step-by-step instructions for registering a Cloth account, downloading, and installing the software, including system requirements and initial setup configurations. ### Account Registration - Visit the official Chinese website: [cloth3d-china.com](https://cloth3d-china.com). - Click the login button (top right), then select the registration option (bottom right). - Choose personal or student registration. - Enter email and mobile phone number; complete mobile verification. - Optionally subscribe to product-related emails. - Complete email verification via the confirmation link sent to your mailbox. - The same Cloth account works across all Cloth products (software, website platform, Connect merchant). ### Software Download and Installation - New users receive a 14-day free trial of the Cloth software. - Download the installation package suitable for your OS (Mac or Windows). - Verify computer performance meets minimum requirements via the link on the download page. - Recommended installation directory: C drive. - Run the installer as administrator and follow the prompts. - After installation, launch the software from the desktop icon. ### Initial Login and Settings - On first launch, agree to service terms. - Login using the registered Clothset credentials (email and password). - Set language preference (default: Simplified Chinese). - The software displays trial period expiration and subscription options. - Subscription plans are available on the official website under "Pricing." ### Language Switching - Interface language can be changed via the top settings menu. - Restart the software after changing the language to apply changes. --- ## Learning Resources and Course Structure This section explains the available learning materials, course format, and additional educational content for different skill levels. ### Learning Resources - The official website’s Learning tab includes tutorials, training camps, handbooks, and community forums. - Tutorials link to the official Cloth Bilibili account where updated videos are regularly posted. - Continuous updates include small technique videos (e.g., button wearing, connection advantages, custom buttons). ### Course Series - **Entry Course (Beginner Level):** Focuses on basic Cloth tools and fundamental 3D clothing production processes. - Divided into two stages; first half released, second half forthcoming. - Emphasizes understanding the Cloth product ecosystem and preparing learners with foundational knowledge.

chunks.title: [CLO Beginner's Guide] Course Introduction
chunks.content: ### Learning Resources - The official website’s Learning tab includes tutorials, training camps, handbooks, and community forums. - Tutorials link to the official Cloth Bilibili account where updated videos are regularly posted. - Continuous updates include small technique videos (e.g., button wearing, connection advantages, custom buttons). ### Course Series - **Entry Course (Beginner Level):** Focuses on basic Cloth tools and fundamental 3D clothing production processes. - Divided into two stages; first half released, second half forthcoming. - Emphasizes understanding the Cloth product ecosystem and preparing learners with foundational knowledge. - **Designers’ Specialties (Intermediate Level):** - Designed for designers wanting to learn 3D design and production from scratch. - Covers clothing sample design, model library modifications, floral and style design skills. - **Master Class (Advanced Level):** - Covers complex product styles, advanced fabric processing, scenery construction, and rendering. - Suitable for advanced users or those with specialized production needs. ### Updates and New Features - New software versions are accompanied by tutorial videos covering new functions and technology upgrades. --- ## Detailed Course Content Outline This section provides a breakdown of the entry course modules and key learning objectives. 1. **Cloth Ecosystem Introduction:** Overview of Cloth product ecosystem and initial preparation. 2. **Core Tools (Steps 3 and 4):** Mastery of basic Cloth tools and 3D clothing production processes. 3. **Material (Step 5):** Concepts and applications of material analysis. 4. **Simulation Control (Step 6):** Practical case studies to improve 3D garment simulation control. --- ## Course Materials Acquisition Instructions for obtaining course-related resources, including Cloth file materials and reference images. ### Cloth File Materials - Available via Connect Business inside Cloth software. - Access through the blue icon (upper right), then the library, and switch to the Connect tab. - Use keyword search or selection filters to find materials. - Materials can be added to the shopping cart or opened on the Connect webpage. ### Reference Pictures - All reference images used in teaching are provided via a network disk link associated with the course video. - Users may also use their own images for creation. --- ## Additional Educational Opportunities This section details extended learning options beyond the core course. - Regular training camps. - Customized courses for business and university users. - Senior talent classes available for face-to-face public registration. --- ## Support and Community Engagement Guidance on accessing manuals, finding help, and participating in the Cloth user community. - Manuals provide function instructions accessible within the software. - The community forum is available via the official website’s Learning menu. - Users can discuss software issues, share works, and participate in events. - The community hosts creative competitions with prizes and gifts. --- # Summary This introduction covers everything from creating a Cloth account, downloading and installing the software, to accessing comprehensive learning resources and community support. The structured course design supports beginners through advanced users to master 3D fashion design using Cloth 3D software.
